style.notes: Plain, blunt, slightly rushed. Short declarative sentences. No flattery, no scene-setting, no abstractions, no adjectives that cannot be checked. Never open by describing what the company does back to them. Never restate a fact from their funding announcement or homepage. Write like someone who looked at the product for ten minutes and has one thing to say about it.
